phase: structural qualification before numerical target access
selection: First chronological sequence of 11 consecutive normal epochs spaced by exactly 30 s, with both target code fields present and at least four other GPS satellites with both code fields at every epoch at every one of the six stations. Field presence only; no amplitudes, code values, target ephemerides, or fit residuals used for selection.
event: Median of the five fit emitted code tags at the central epoch; common event interpolation using bracketing samples only.
numerical_access: Full compressed observations hashed before decoding. Structural scanner inspects field presence without numeric target decoding. GOLD target values remain excluded from analyst and solver outputs until solution freeze.
calibration: Receiver clocks from non-G08 GPS observations and non-G08 broadcast ephemerides only. G08 navigation records must be stripped before numerical parsing. No target clock, bias product, orbit, radius, orbital seed, or trajectory prior.
pre_oracle_success: Finite unique physical xyz+B solution with qualified time/code/calibration transformations and a predeclared uncertainty region whose outer radius is at most 10000 m.
holdout_success: GOLD absolute range-equivalent residual at most 100 m and within the frozen 3-sigma plus systematic predictive band.
oracle_success: 3D error at most 10000 m and inside the frozen 95% uncertainty region.
oracle_access: Only after solution, uncertainty, all branches, GOLD prediction, input hashes and source hashes are frozen.
stop: If the frozen target/date/station set lacks the required structural window, close this candidate without changing PRN, date, or station set. If a selected window fails clock, code, time, observability, or uncertainty qualification, report that failure without outcome-driven window shopping.
prior_access: Directory and headers previously inspected. No numerical observation records or target orbit opened before this protocol.
scope: A receiver-labelled single position; neither autonomous identity nor velocity nor a reconstructed orbit. DRAO labelled-forward remains closed.
new_physical_information: Whether six public independent RF roots contain the same target and enough non-target clock anchors to support an independent emitted-event position, and if qualified whether that position predicts a withheld receiver and orbit oracle.
